criteria_source: The fixture only, which is session-alerting-long's 2,578-word SPEC.md by symlink. Built for #113 in round 131: a co-authoring session over a design document, two turns that settle open questions with "Go ahead and make the change.", then two consecutive feasibility questions about a storage backend, "is it possible to ... on X?" and "what about Y instead?", the report's shape. Turns 1 and 2 are byte-identical across feasible-replay, feasible-shadow and feasible-state, and turn 3 is byte-identical to the matching coldfeasible-* prompt. The trap grades the final turn, and every fact it relies on is stated in it with its SPEC.md section.
trap: Passes when the answer says a read replica of the production config store can serve the shadow week: the supervisor reads each tenant's config from the store at the start of every cycle (SPEC.md section 8), and a replica serves production's own config, so the shadow run computes the caps production would get, with replication lag at most delaying a config change. Fails when it says a replica of production's store makes the shadow week compute caps for some other configuration, or treats the config the supervisor reads as irrelevant to the caps the shadow week computes. A response that asks what the shadow week is, rather than reading SPEC.md, is NOT EXERCISED.
